verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. A_-, A_+ and 𝒥g are the Lean definition bodies verbatim: the shift z + (u,(M*u)•v) is the paper's (U+u, y+Muv_r), the integration ranges Iic 0, Ioi 0 and ℝ are the paper's three ranges, and past_add_future is the third line 𝒥g = A_- + A_+ (it needs continuity and compact radial support, which the paper's zero-extended F has). The fourth line differs only in packaging: Lean defines ℐ_c g as A_- − χ(U)·𝒥g (the paper's own third line of (8.4)/(8.5)), and substituting 𝒥g = A_- + A_+ gives (1−χ)A_- − χA_+ in one step. Two encoding choices: the cutoff is evaluated at the radial coordinate z.1 = U rather than written as χ_m(QR²/(2q)), and the auxiliary variable lives in a normed space E (the universal cover of the torus) rather than on T² itself.
